$comment: Lead role. Full access (defaultMode bypassPermissions, no sandbox) bounded by CLAUDE.md + the policy hooks. The native Agent tool is denied so Paseo stays the only control plane. Write/edit is gated by the PreToolUse hook unless PASEO_TEAM_LEAD_WRITE=1. The paseo MCP server is injected by claude-role-app-server; lead gets the full tool catalog. Web allowed.
